nodes.label: D-FINE: Redefining Bounding Box Regression in DETR
nodes.rationale: Introduces D-FINE, FDR, and GO-LSD for real-time object detection.

nodes.label: Global Optimal Localization Self-Distillation (GO-LSD)
nodes.rationale: Distills localization knowledge from final layers to shallower layers using a unified union set of matches.

nodes.label: Fine-grained Distribution Refinement (FDR)
nodes.rationale: Redefines bounding box regression by refining probability distributions.
